simple.summary: הֲנָחָה (hănâchâh) means permission of rest , i.e. quiet First listed occurrence: Esth 2 18.

definitions.full: H2010. hanachah הֲנָחָה noun feminine a giving of rest , i.e. perhaps holiday-making (compare נוח Hiph`il A ; properly Infinitive, Sta § 621 c Ba NB 90 , compare Kö ii. 1, 402 ); — ׳וַה עָשָׂה לַמְּדִינוֺת Est 2:18 and a holiday-making for the provinces be enacted , ᵑ9 requies ; but ᵐ5 ἄφεσις , whence al. release from taxes, or amnesty .
